familiar.text: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

verses.restored: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

verses.restored: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

familiar.text: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

verses.restored: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.restored: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
